name: Sailor Pluto Tentacle Game
source:
Fan made visual novel featuring Sailor Pluto, created using art by Taiyoukei Kaihatsu Kikou (Japanese doujinshi circle). Setsuna works at school and one evening she notices some strange events are about to happend there.
Events and ending depend on your choices during the game.
translation:
范制作了以水手冥王星为主题的视觉小说，由太阳系开发纪工（日本同人志圈）创作。刹那在学校工作，有一天晚上，她注意到学校即将发生一些奇怪的事件。
事件和结局取决于你在游戏中的选择。
